response.rationale: The item is a home-category product (not electronics), is not final sale, not under fraud hold, and delivered 9 days ago—within the standard 30-day window. RET-007 applies (days_since_delivery <= 30 and final_sale == False). No higher-priority rule is triggered: RET-012 (final sale), RET-020 (defective), RET-050 (goodwill), RET-051 (fraud hold), and the electronics rules all have false conditions on these facts. The customer simply no longer needs the item, which does not affect eligibility.
